headline: SAFF holds at 4.32 on Female Daily (1,746 reviews) for a sixth flat day; the new ALENCINE and MECHLINE Extraits launch at Rp409k with art packaging, a premium step that still needs first reviews.
kpis_note: Awareness and NPS need a consumer survey; they are not measured from public web data.

insights.text: Female Daily ratings are flat for a sixth day: SAFF 4.32 on 1,746 reviews, HMNS 4.15, Mykonos 4.26, Alchemist 4.43. Alchemist is 0.03 below 30 Oct (4.46); no product rating changed vs yesterday.
On Shopee, SAFF holds 3.53% perfume market share in Q2 2026, 4th behind Mykonos (6.78%), Scarlett and HMNS (5.09%): high review quality is not yet top volume.
SAFF is moving up in price: ALENCINE and MECHLINE sell at Rp409k (core Extraits about Rp208k–249k), on sale in Indonesia and Malaysia since 25 Oct, plus a 4-scent Deo Potion at about Rp109k.
S.O.T.B still holds a third of SAFF's reviews at 4.1; Ostara (also 4.1, 92% recommend) shows the same pattern: good wear time but 'too strong' for some, and its all-black bottle hides the fill level.
Longevity is mixed by scent: Omnia gets 98% recommend for all-day wear and Eulalie made a 29 Oct 'long-lasting amberwood' list, while Las Pozas and Troupe reviewers report only 4–6 hours.

recommendations.text: Check that the Deo Potion '48-hour' and skin-benefit claims are backed by tests and worded the same on every channel; watch first reviews for skin reaction.

Set clear longevity expectations per scent (hours on skin vs fabric) so the 'Extrait' label does not over-promise, especially for the Rp409k ALENCINE/MECHLINE; start with Troupe, Cascavel and S.O.T.B, and add wear tips.
Close the Shopee gap with Mykonos and HMNS: push top-rated scents (Xocolatl, Irai Leima, Omnia, Troupe) and the new collections with review highlights and creator content on Shopee and Instagram.
Packaging: add a fill-level window or lighter bottle option (Ostara, Eulalie) and a travel size; ask QC to check leaks and outer-box damage in shipping.
Run a short quarterly survey (awareness, consideration, NPS), post a 'how to spot a fake' guide on SAFF channels, and upload a marketplace export to the Drive folder to measure low-star drivers.
